description: Step-level evidence audit across all 9 TB phenotypes: how many causal steps each chain needs, and what source type of evidence supports each step
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

# Step-level audit. One row per causal step in each wired chain.
# src: HUMAN_INT (human interventional), HUMAN_OBS (human clinical observational),
#      MODEL (model organism), INVITRO, COMPUT, NONE (no located evidence)
rows = [
 ("Chronic Cough","Tissue damage leads to endobronchial granulomatous inflammation","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Chronic Cough","Endobronchial ulceration leads to airway receptor stimulation","NONE"),
 ("Chronic Cough","Airway receptor stimulation results in chronic cough","HUMAN_OBS"),

 ("Fever","Infection leads to systemic IL-6 / TNF response","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Fever","Circulating cytokine leads to brain endothelial COX-2 and PGE2","MODEL"),
 ("Fever","PGE2 leads to raised preoptic thermoregulatory set point","MODEL"),
 ("Fever","Raised set point results in thermogenesis and fever","MODEL"),

 ("Night Sweats","Mechanism unknown","NONE"),

 ("Weight Loss","Infection leads to systemic TNF response","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Weight Loss","TNF leads to muscle proteolysis and negative nitrogen balance","HUMAN_INT"),
 ("Weight Loss","Negative nitrogen balance results in weight loss","HUMAN_INT"),
 ("Weight Loss","Inflammation leads to peptide YY elevation","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Weight Loss","Peptide YY elevation leads to appetite suppression","HUMAN_OBS"),

 ("Hemoptysis","Cavitation leads to pulmonary artery wall erosion (Rasmussen)","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Hemoptysis","Cavitation leads to systemic arterial neovascularisation","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Hemoptysis","Vessel rupture into the airway results in hemoptysis","HUMAN_INT"),

 ("Chest Pain","Tissue damage leads to pleural space seeding","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Chest Pain","Pleural seeding leads to parietal pleural granulomatous inflammation","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Chest Pain","Pleural inflammation leads to parietal nociceptor activation","NONE"),
 ("Chest Pain","Nociceptor activation results in pleuritic chest pain","HUMAN_OBS"),

 ("Fatigue","Infection leads to raised IL-6","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Fatigue","IL-6 leads to hepatic hepcidin induction","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Fatigue","Hepcidin leads to ferroportin internalisation and iron sequestration","INVITRO"),
 ("Fatigue","Iron sequestration leads to iron-restricted erythropoiesis and anaemia","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Fatigue","Anaemia results in fatigue","NONE"),

 ("Back Pain","Pulmonary infection leads to haematogenous dissemination","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Back Pain","Dissemination seeds vertebral bodies via Batson venous plexus","MODEL"),
 ("Back Pain","Vertebral seeding leads to spondylodiscitis with bone destruction","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Back Pain","Spondylodiscitis results in back pain","HUMAN_OBS"),

 ("Lymphadenopathy","Infected myeloid cells travel by lymphatics to draining nodes","COMPUT"),
 ("Lymphadenopathy","Nodal infection leads to granulomatous lymphadenitis with caseation","HUMAN_OBS"),
 ("Lymphadenopathy","Granulomas efface nodal architecture, results in lymphadenopathy","HUMAN_OBS"),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["phenotype","step","src"])

grade = {"Weight Loss":"ESTABLISHED","Hemoptysis":"ESTABLISHED","Chronic Cough":"SUPPORTED",
         "Fever":"SUPPORTED","Chest Pain":"SUPPORTED","Fatigue":"SUPPORTED",
         "Back Pain":"SUPPORTED","Lymphadenopathy":"SUPPORTED","Night Sweats":"NOT_ESTABLISHED"}
order = ["Weight Loss","Hemoptysis","Lymphadenopathy","Back Pain","Chest Pain",
         "Chronic Cough","Fatigue","Fever","Night Sweats"]

cats = ["HUMAN_INT","HUMAN_OBS","INVITRO","MODEL","COMPUT","NONE"]
labels = {"HUMAN_INT":"Human interventional","HUMAN_OBS":"Human clinical observational",
          "INVITRO":"In vitro","MODEL":"Model organism","COMPUT":"Computational",
          "NONE":"No evidence located"}
cols = {"HUMAN_INT":"#1a5c38","HUMAN_OBS":"#4fa36f","INVITRO":"#9ec9b0",
        "MODEL":"#e0a458","COMPUT":"#c97b84","NONE":"#b8b8b8"}

mat = df.pivot_table(index="phenotype", columns="src", aggfunc="size", fill_value=0)
mat = mat.reindex(index=order, columns=cats, fill_value=0)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5.6),
                       gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[3.0, 1.0]})

left = np.zeros(len(order))
for c in cats:
    ax[0].barh(order, mat[c].values, left=left, color=cols[c], edgecolor="white", height=0.68)
    left += mat[c].values
ax[0].invert_yaxis()
ax[0].set_xlabel("Number of causal steps in the wired chain")
ax[0].set_title("Evidence source type for every step of each phenotype chain", loc="left")
ax[0].legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor=cols[c], label=labels[c]) for c in cats],
             loc="lower right", frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)
ax[0].set_xlim(0, 6)
ax[0].grid(axis="x", alpha=0.25)
ax[0].set_axisbelow(True)

# fraction of each chain that rests on human evidence
frac = ((mat["HUMAN_INT"] + mat["HUMAN_OBS"]) / mat.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0)
gcol = {"ESTABLISHED":"#1a5c38","SUPPORTED":"#4fa36f","NOT_ESTABLISHED":"#b8b8b8"}
ax[1].barh(order, frac.values, color=[gcol[grade[p]] for p in order], height=0.68)
ax[1].invert_yaxis()
ax[1].set_yticks([])
ax[1].set_xlim(0, 1.0)
ax[1].set_xlabel("Fraction of steps with human evidence")
ax[1].set_title("Chain grade", loc="left")
for i, p in enumerate(order):
    ax[1].text(0.02, i, grade[p], va="center", fontsize=8,
               color="white" if frac[p] > 0.35 else "black")
ax[1].grid(axis="x", alpha=0.25); ax[1].set_axisbelow(True)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print(df.groupby("src").size().reindex(cats).fillna(0).astype(int).to_string())
print("\nTotal causal steps audited:", len(df))
print("Steps resting on human evidence: %d of %d (%.0f%%)" % (
    (df.src.isin(["HUMAN_INT","HUMAN_OBS"])).sum(), len(df),
    100*(df.src.isin(["HUMAN_INT","HUMAN_OBS"])).mean()))
print("\nPer-phenotype human-evidence fraction:")
print(frac.round(2).to_string())
